decisions.reason: The margin analysis builds on the established offer and kept its own website page in both years, a visible and continued commitment that fits the platform direction, so management will persist with it.

The calculator was downgraded from its own page to a mention and sibling tariff products were already removed, but it sits close to the core data business, so keeping it costs little and dropping it would admit a misstep.

The area definition tool lost its own page, which signals weaker commitment, yet it likely supports the location-based analyses and the central platform, so management will probably keep it integrated rather than write it off.
